responses: Hello! Welcome to MKM Group of Colleges For Girls Help Bot. How can I help you? You can ask about courses, fees, bus, hostel, admission.
MKM Group of Colleges for Girls was established in 1998 at Hodal, Palwal. Affiliated to MDU Rohtak and DCRUST Murthal. NAAC accredited college for girls.
MCA is 2 years course (4 semesters). Total fees Rs 2.5 Lakhs. Eligibility: BCA/BSc with 50% + Maths. Duration 2 Years.
BCA is 3 years course. Total fees Rs 1.8 Lakhs (60k per year). Eligibility: 12th with 50% + English. Best for IT jobs.
MBA is 2 years course. Total fees Rs 2 Lakhs. Specialization in HR, Finance, Marketing. Eligibility: Graduation with 50%.
BBA is 3 years course. Total fees Rs 1.5 Lakhs. Eligibility: 12th with 50%. Good for management career.
B.Sc is 3 years course. We offer Medical & Non-Medical. Fees Rs 90,000 total. Eligibility: 12th with Science.
M.Sc is 2 years course. Available in Physics, Chemistry, Maths, CS. Fees Rs 1.2 Lakhs. Eligibility: Graduation with 50%.
B.Com is 3 years course. Total fees Rs 75,000. Eligibility: 12th with Commerce/Arts with 50%.
M.Com is 2 years course. Total fees Rs 60,000. Eligibility: B.Com with 50%.
BA is 3 years course. Total fees Rs 60,000. Subjects: Hindi, English, History, Political Science, etc. Eligibility: 12th pass.
MA is 2 years course. Fees Rs 50,000. Available in Hindi, English, History. Eligibility: BA with 50%.
B.Ed is 2 years course. Total fees Rs 1.2 Lakhs. Eligibility: Graduation with 50%. Compulsory for teaching jobs.
Diploma is 1 year course. We offer DCA, PGDCA, Fashion Designing. Fees Rs 30,000 - 50,000.
We offer B.Sc, M.Sc, BCA, MCA, BBA, MBA, B.Com, M.Com, BA, MA, B.Ed and Diploma courses.
Admission open for 2025-26. Process: Visit college with 10th, 12th, Graduation docs. Fill form + 5000 registration. Merit based admission. Last date 31 July.
Yes, bus facility is available for Palwal, Hodal, Hathin, Nuh, Ballabgarh and nearby areas. Contact admin office 7082929917 for routes and fees.
Yes, Girls hostel available inside campus with full security. Fees Rs 7000-14000 per year + Mess extra. Rooms with fan, bed, almirah.
Yes, Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC and meritorious students (80% above). Haryana Govt. PMS scholarship applicable.
Placement cell available. Companies like Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCL, ICICI Bank visit. Average package 2.5 LPA. 70% students placed.
Big Library with 15000+ books, journals, e-books. Open 9AM to 4PM. Free Wi-Fi and computer facility.
Canteen with hygienic food available. Sports ground for Volleyball, Badminton, Kho-Kho. Annual sports meet also.
College timing 9:00 AM to 3:30 PM, Monday to Saturday. Sunday closed. Office timing 9AM to 4PM.
Address: Near Bus Stand, Hodal, Palwal - 121106, Haryana. Phone: 7082929917, Email: mkmhodal@gmail.com. Google Map: MKM College Hodal.
